info.title: Cropbox Web API
info.description: HTTP interface to a Cropbox system. Every POST request is stateless: the body is parsed, the fields it leaves out are filled in from the trusted `request_defaults` of the server (what the client sends wins), and the request is dispatched to `simulate`, `visualize`, `evaluate` or `calibrate`. A request that the model or its data cannot take is rejected (422 `validation`) before or apart from the run: a field that the operation or one of its objects does not define, a value in a unit or shape its parameter does not take, observations that match no output. A failure while the model runs is a 500 (`execution`). Model-specific metadata comes from `GET /api/model`.

get.description: Systems, parameters with defaults, output variables and provided-table bindings of the served system.
What the bundled dashboard is built from: editable controls, selectable outputs and plot panels derived from the model description, and the `stop` and `snap` that the service defaults to.
The route table and the component schemas of this document as `definitions`, which they refer to each other by.

post.description: Draws one table, `y` against `x`: the table passed as `data`, or the one from simulating the model (`config`, `stop`, `snap`, `base`, `xstep`). This is the table form of `visualize`; its grouped, layered and observation forms are not available over HTTP.

Value.description: A scalar or array with an optional unit and type. Plain JSON numbers, booleans and strings are accepted wherever a Value is expected.

timezone.description: IANA zone of a `ZonedDateTime`. A value without an offset requires it; a value in a zone with daylight saving time carries it, so that the zone survives the round trip.

TypeName.description: Julia type name. On input `Bool`, `Int`/`Int64`, `Float64`, `String`, `Symbol`, `Date`, `DateTime` and `ZonedDateTime` convert the value (element-wise for arrays); any other name is informative and leaves the value as parsed.

Table.description: A table given as CSV text or as columns and row arrays; a TablePayload response is one of the latter and can be sent back as it is. CSV headers may carry `name (unit)` or `name (:Type)` annotations when no `columns` are given. No column name may end in parentheses otherwise. Column names are unique and a row has no more cells than there are columns; a cell that is absent or null is a missing value.

Config.description: Parameter values keyed by `System.name` paths, or nested `{System: {name: value}}` objects. Both shapes may be mixed. A parameter of the model is addressed by its name or alias under its system or a mixin of it, and takes precedence over the server's value whichever of those either side used; other paths are rejected. A parameter of a scalar type takes one value, and a quantity in a unit that converts to the declared one. Table parameters take a Table.

Names.description: Variable paths such as `leaf.area`, by name or alias; `*` and `leaf.*` select every variable of a system, `time` is the clock time, and an object maps output column names to paths. Paths are checked against the model; indexed paths such as `leaves[1].area` are resolved at run time.

Meta.description: Extra result columns: a system name adds that system's configured parameters (which tells the runs of `configs` apart), an object adds constant columns, and an array combines them.

RunRequest.description: Fields shared by simulation, evaluation and calibration requests.

configs.description: Several configurations, each merged over `config`, producing a stacked table.

base.description: Path of the system (`leaf`) that `target`, `index`, `x` and `y` are relative to.

stop.description: Update count (number), duration (`{value, unit}` in a unit of the clock time) or the path of a count or condition variable (string).

snap.description: Snapshot interval (`{value, unit}` in a unit of the clock time), a boolean or the path of a condition variable.

VisualizationRequest.description: Plots the table given as `data`, whose columns `x` and `y` then name, or else simulates the model (`config`, `base`, `stop`, `snap`, `xstep`) and plots the variables `x` and `y`. A single `y` is named on its axis and several in a legend.

xstep.description: A parameter varied across simulations, as a range (`start`, `stop`, `step`) or explicit `values`, in `unit`.

plot.description: Plot options: title, xlab, ylab, legend, legendpos, names, colors, xlim and ylim (`[lower, upper]`, either may be null), xunit, yunit, aspect, and linestyle (`solid`, `dash`, `dot`, `dashdot` or `dashdotdot`, one or one for each of `y`).

data.description: Plot this table instead of simulating.

parameters.description: Bounds per parameter path: `[lower, upper]` or `{lower, upper, unit}`, in the same flat or nested shape as `config`. A path that several systems share through a mixin is calibrated through the path of one of them.

optim.description: Options for the BlackBoxOptim optimizer (e.g. `MaxSteps`, `Method`, `PopulationSize`), except those that write files where the service runs (`SaveTrace`, `SaveFitnessTraceToCsv`, `SaveParameters`).

rows.description: Plain values; non-finite numbers and missing values are null.

value.description: A Value object, or an array of them for several targets.

config.description: Nested `{System: {name: Value}}` objects with values in the declared units of their parameters (keyed by metric tuple when `pareto` is set).

path.description: Access path from the root; null for a system that the model only produces while it runs.

declared.description: Configuration path through the declaring system (differs from `path` for mixins).

target.description: Access path usable in `target`, `index`, `stop`, `x`, `y`; null for a parameter of a produced system.

default.description: Value object with the value in effect under the server configuration, which a client can send back (parameters only; null for tables).

index.description: Index column of a provided table (tables only).

simulation.description: The `stop` and `snap` among the `request_defaults` of the service, as a request takes them, for a client to start from. `stop` is five units of the clock time when the service has none; `snap` is null when it has none or one only Julia can express.

panels.description: Plots of `outputs` targets, which include every variable a panel names.

linestyles.description: One line style for each of `y`.

xstep.description: Path of the entry of `sweeps` that the panel simulates over.

sweeps.description: Parameter sweeps for panels: the fields of `xstep` in a visualization request, with an optional `label`.

timezone.description: Zone of a `ZonedDateTime` default, to send along with an edited value.

default_filename.description: Name of the table the server already provides (table inputs).
